title: Complexity of tolerant monotonicity testing
formal: Determine the query complexity of distinguishing Boolean functions on \(\{0,1\}^n\) that are \(\varepsilon_1\)-close to monotone from those \(\varepsilon_2\)-far, for fixed \(0<\varepsilon_1<\varepsilon_2<1\).

import_provenance.original_title: The complexity of tolerant monotonicity testing
import_provenance.original_statement: Determine the query complexity of distinguishing Boolean functions on {0,1}^n that are ε₁-close to monotone from those ε₂-far, for fixed 0<ε₁<ε₂. Even nonadaptive testing has an exponential gap in the exponent between 2^{Ω(n^{1/4})} lower bounds and roughly 2^{Õ(√n)} upper bounds; the power of adaptivity is also unresolved.
